EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Delete/Undo behavior across multiple wishlists can regress as list-item relationships change.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Add the same SKU into at least two custom wishlists and All Items. Delete from All Items, verify removal from all linked lists, then trigger Undo immediately and verify restoration in each list.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Delete removes the SKU from all intended list contexts; Undo restores prior list associations without duplication, stale counters, or ghost entries.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR #825 (G2-22969) and PR #845 (G2-23030) in mytheresa/atelier indicate recent high-change surface for relationship consistency.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: MRP-specific backend error-message behavior for create/rename requires explicit cross-brand check.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: In MRP acceptance, attempt create/rename with a duplicated list name and with an invalid/edge input. Capture modal error text and recovery path, then compare with NAP behavior for equivalent steps.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: MRP shows clear, non-duplicated error text, modal remains recoverable, and user can retry/cancel without losing context.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR #776 (G2-23730) targets duplicated default wishlist name error text, so wording and recovery should be regression-checked.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Auth handoff during wishlist actions may regress with session transitions.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: From PDP and MiniPDP while logged out, initiate add-to-wishlist, complete login, and verify post-login continuation preserves the selected target wishlist and pending user intent.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: No dropped intent, no duplicate adds, and user lands in a valid wishlist context with expected selector state.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: No direct PR key hit found for G2-20842 in mytheresa/atelier; keep this as a high-priority exploratory continuity check.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Wishlist navigation state can desync across icon actions, truncation/collapse behavior, and single-list redirect.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Verify create/edit icon visibility by context, long-title truncation and collapse behavior on smaller breakpoints, and direct redirect for single-wishlist accounts from nav entry points.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Navigation controls remain context-correct, long names do not break layout, and single-list users bypass unnecessary selection steps.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR #559 (G2-19105), PR #598 (G2-22343), and PR #778 (G2-23523) indicate related navigation behavior areas that should be validated together.
